digest:
- The US Department of Labor is returning to a Trump-era standard regarding independent contractors. This could ease classification liability for gig delivery and courier fleets entering our last-mile commercial auto footprint [1].
- A trucking survey shows 61% of US respondents anticipate freight market recovery in 2027. This broad carrier optimism suggests potential freight growth, though macro trucking trends may diverge from dedicated parcel delivery fleet economics [3].
- Optalitix introduced agentic AI tools into its quote platform to automate complex underwriting workflows. This provides relevant operating efficiency tooling for MGAs, though it is not specific to last-mile commercial auto [2].
